comment: Minimum PASSING test count per workspace, checked by scripts/check-test-floor.mjs. This is a RATCHET against a suite that silently shrinks, not a coverage target. It exists because `--experimental-test-isolation=none` (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) swallows a module-level throw once any test in that file has registered: the run goes green, exits 0, and simply reports fewer tests. Measured: 2174 instead of 2175, with `# fail 0`. A count floor is the only thing that turns that back into a red. Raise these when tests are added; lowering one is a deliberate act that should be explained in the commit. LOWERED 2026-08-19: backthread 729 -> 714 (712 after the removal, +3 for the retired-name tests: two behavioural, one over its source). The pre-edit PreToolUse hook was removed (founder decision, see cli/hooks/hooks.json's $comment_no_pretooluse_edit), retiring editNudge.test.ts's 15 tests and 2 `edit-context` dispatch tests in bin.test.ts. The suite shrank because the feature did, not because tests were dropped: the case that pinned the hook's existence was INVERTED into a guard in plugin.test.ts rather than deleted. RAISED 2026-08-21: backthread 715 -> 780 for src/failureCopy.test.ts and the four --verbose dispatch tests in bin.test.ts. +51 = 20 renderer/registry cases, 24 conformance cases (four properties across six endpoints, generated from the registry so the count moves WITH the endpoint list), 4 flag-dispatch cases, 3 net new assertions folded into infer.test.ts, and — after an independent read found two registry entries claiming a failure was 'never shown' on surfaces that PRINT it — the `sync` and `capture --manual` legs, their 8 generated conformance cases, the Functions slug-table cases, and a bare-410 case that a mutant had survived. Nothing was removed; three existing tests changed their expected STRING because the rendered failure changed, which is the point of the change. RAISED 2026-08-19: @backthread/extractor 2175 -> 2201 for packages/extractor/src/safety.test.ts — the source-tree budget and its symlink-escape guard, which previously had no test that failed when it broke.
